tagline: Where others see waste, we see valuable resources
hero_kpi_rationale: TOMRA generates exceptional operating cash flow of 235 million euros in 2024, up 71.5% versus 2023, demonstrating the strength of the business model and the quality of earnings from core operations, which is key to funding investments in circular innovation and resource optimization.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned by the company over the year.
kpis.description: TOMRA achieved record revenue of 1.348 billion euros in 2024, growing 4.6% versus 2023.
kpis.signal: Record revenue in 2024 despite challenging macro environment.

kpis.name: EBITA Margin
kpis.description: EBITA margin stood at 13.0% in 2024, up sharply from 9.2% in 2023, driven by efficiency gains and restructuring.
kpis.signal: Significant margin improvement despite unfavorable macro conditions.

kpis.name: Operating Profit
kpis.explanation: Profit generated by core business operations.
kpis.description: Operating profit reached 156 million euros in 2024, up sharply from 101 million in 2023.

kpis.short: Net cash flow from operating activities
kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.description: Operating cash flow jumped to 235 million euros in 2024, versus 137 million in 2023.
kpis.signal: Very strong improvement in cash generation.

kpis.name: Return on Capital Employed
kpis.explanation: Profit generated relative to invested capital.
kpis.description: ROIC stood at 17.9% in 2024, up significantly from 12.7% in 2023.

kpis.name: Headcount (Employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Total headcount was 5,303 employees at end of 2024, down from 5,370 in 2023, following restructuring aimed at efficiency gains.

kpis.name: Share of AI-Integrated Solutions
kpis.explanation: Percentage of commercialized solutions incorporating artificial intelligence capabilities in TOMRA's portfolio.
kpis.description: TOMRA has commercialized three key AI-enabled solutions: AUTOSORT PULSE for aluminum alloy sorting, GAINnext and OBTAIN in recycling, and LUCAi and Basic Line in collection, marking growing adoption of AI across its products.
kpis.signal: TOMRA progressively integrating AI into its industrial sorting and resource recovery solutions.

risks.title: Dependence on deposit system regulation
risks.score_rationale: Major risk flagged at introduction (Item 1A) with strong language: 'If a country decides to repeal recycling regulation or abolish an existing deposit system, TOMRA's technology could become obsolete'. Central to strategy (87,000 machines installed). Trend: stable but with growing dependence on new markets (Poland, Greece, Portugal, Singapore, Tasmania, Uruguay). Weight in category: critical for Collection Solutions.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and IT systems resilience
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned risk with track record: 'Following a cyberattack in 2023, we significantly upgraded our infrastructure to become more resilient'. Moderate-to-high intensity language describing potential impacts (operational disruptions, intentional/unintentional acts, natural disasters, war, telecom outages). Trend: up (post-2023 improvements indicate risk recognition). Weight in category: high for global operations.

risks.title: Cyclicality of customer capex and raw material price volatility
risks.score_rationale: Specific business risk detailed in TOMRA Food and Recycling: 'Equipment investments come in cycles for a specific food category' and 'Market sentiment depends on raw material prices and level of economic activity'. Moderate-to-high intensity language. Trend: stable with recent volatility (weak sentiment on European plastics in 2024, recovery signs late 2024). Weight in category: critical for Food and Recycling.

risks.title: Technology leadership and intense competition in food sorting
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk: 'TOMRA's success depends on its ability to maintain technology leadership in the sorting market' and 'The competitive landscape in food sorting and grading remains active and fragmented'. Moderate intensity language. Trend: stable with increasing pressure (new AI/LIBS technologies recently launched). Weight in category: high for Food and Recycling.

risks.title: Customer concentration: major retailers and processors
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned: 'TOMRA's customers include some of the world's largest retail chains, raw material processors and major food producers where unpaid receivables can be significant'. Moderate language. Trend: stable (historically minimal losses, credit routines in place). Weight in category: moderate but notable customer concentration.

risks.title: Technology obsolescence from regulatory change
risks.score_rationale: Specific risk to Collection Solutions: 'If a country decides to repeal recycling regulation or abolish an existing deposit system, TOMRA's technology could become obsolete'. High intensity language. Trend: stable but with growing exposure to new markets. Weight in category: critical for installed base of 87,000 machines.

risks.title: Limited availability of recycled feedstock
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified for TOMRA Feedstock: 'With rising demand for recycled content but limited availability of raw material for recycling'. Moderate language. Trend: up (TOMRA investing in two post-consumer plastic sorting facilities). Weight in category: moderate but growing for circular strategy.

risks.title: Uncertainty on new market materialization and timing
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk: 'Which markets will materialize and timing is uncertain and typically depends on the outcome of political processes'. Moderate language. Trend: stable with growing exposure (Poland, Greece, Portugal, Singapore, Tasmania, Uruguay in pipeline). Weight in category: moderate for strategic planning.

ai_positioning.summary: TOMRA is integrating artificial intelligence into its industrial solutions to improve sorting, resource recovery and optimization. AI is used operationally across several commercial products spanning its three main divisions.
evidence: Launch of AUTOSORT PULSE for aluminum alloy sorting with AI
GAINnext and OBTAIN solutions in TOMRA Recycling using AI
Basic Line in TOMRA Collection and LUCAi in TOMRA Food with embedded AI
